programme.title: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America
programme.desc: Reconstruction of the dramatic events that took place on April 19, 1995.In front of the federal building.Alfred P. Murrah's truck filled with ammonium nitrate exploded in Oklahoma City.It was the largest terrorist attack in the United States before the attack of September 11, 2001.30 years after the explosion, witnesses and survivors of the tragedy will speak out.Memories will be shared by, among others:Bill Clinton, former Gov. Frank Keating, Amy Downs, who was trapped under the rubble for hours, and Fire Chief Mike Shannon.FBI agent Bob Ricks will show you what it was like to race against time to arrest the attackers and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana Van Zeller
programme.desc: Correspondent Mariana van Zeller has been following the trail of smugglers for over fifteen years.During his dangerous work, he meets not only criminals, but also representatives of the justice system, former prisoners and members of local communities.The journalist paints a shocking picture of the gray zone where billions of dollars are traded.The reporter will learn about the activities of counterfeiters, drug dealers, and the illegal sale of weapons, fentanyl and animals.Among her interlocutors was Joe Exotic, the former owner of the controversial zoo.In 2019, he was sentenced to 22 years in prison.

programme.title: The Story of God With Morgan Freeman
programme.desc: The series shows the connection between the evolution of religion and civilization, as well as surprising analogies between different faiths, even those that seem to be diametrically different.The host and narrator of the program, Morgan Freeman, seeks answers to questions about fundamental issues related to God and faith, e.g. the creation of the world, the source of evil, and resurrection.The actor travels to the most important places of worship of various religions, including:the Wailing Wall in Jerusalem, the Mayan temple in Guatemala or the Egyptian pyramids.He will confront these spiritual experiences and rituals with the latest scientific achievements.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Extreme African Safari
programme.desc: Master survivalist Hazen Audel will undertake a demanding expedition through the Great Rift Valley, the largest continental rift in the world, which is considered a mecca for wildlife.It is also home to many nomadic tribes.The presenter does not hide the fact that completing the 800-kilometer route is one of his dreams.The traveler will set off during the animal migration season, which will allow him to admire animals living in the savannah up close.The six-episode series will present, among other things, an encounter with majestic elephants.Viewers will also have the opportunity to observe a million-strong flock of flamingos.The escapade would not have been possible without the help of local East Africans.Their invaluable tips allow you to move relatively safely in a land full of steep slopes.
